title: There is Power in the Blood
lyrics_original: Would you be free from the burden of sin?
There’s power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you over evil a victory win?
There’s wonderful power in the blood.
There is power, power, wonder-working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder-working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
Would you be free from your passion and pride?
There’s power in the blood, power in the blood;
Come for a cleansing to Calvary’s tide;
There’s wonderful power in the blood.       ||There is power||
Would you be whiter, much whiter than snow?
There’s power in the blood, power in the blood;
Sin-stains are lost in its life-giving flow;
There’s wonderful power in the blood.        ||There is power||
Would you do service for Jesus your King?
There’s power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
There’s wonderful power in the blood.         ||There is power||

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే ఆయన వెలుగులోనున్న ప్రకారము మనమును వెలుగులో నడిచినయెడల. మనము అన్యోన్యసహవాసము గలవారమై యుందుము; అప్పుడు ఆయన కుమారుడైన యేసు రక్తము ప్రతి ఎ
bible_verses.english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

bible_verses.telugu: వారు గొఱ్ఱపిల్ల రక్తమును బట్టియు, తామిచ్చిన సాక్ష్య మునుబట్టియు వానిని జయించియున్నారు గాని, మరణము వరకు తమ ప్రాణములను ప్రేమించిన వారు కారు.
bible_verses.english: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

bible_verses.telugu: దేవుని కృపామహదైశ్వర్యమునుబట్టి ఆ ప్రియునియందు ఆయన రక్తమువలన మనకు విమో చనము, అనగా మన అపరాధములకు క్షమాపణ  మనకు కలిగియున్నది.
bible_verses.english: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God’s grace.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the precious gift of Your sacrifice that breaks every chain and cleanses my heart. Forgive me for the times I try to overcome my pride and burdens in my own strength. Today, I surrender my struggles to You and trust in the wonder-working power of Your love. Walk with me, Lord, and help me live daily in the joyful freedom You paid so dearly to give me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the precious gift of Your sacrifice that breaks every chain and cleanses my heart. devotional.reflection_english: This classic hymn gently asks us if we desire true freedom from the heavy burdens of sin, pride, and weakness. It points our hearts directly to the cross, reminding us that Jesus’ sacrifice carries real, wonder-working power to heal and redeem us today. As you sing, let go of the struggle to fix yourself in your own strength. Instead, step into the joy and victory found in the unconditional, cleansing grace of the Lamb.
